subject: Invoice creation + billing contact setup for PO 7821
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@horizonhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@horizonhealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice and billing setup for PO 7821

Hi Logan,

We're ready to move forward on the Redwood subscription tied to PO 7821. AP asked whether you can create the invoice and push it to our systems, and whether Redwood will deliver invoices via: 1) vendor portal push (we can pick up), or 2) email PDF to accounts-payable@horizonhealth.com.

A few specifics from our side:
- PO number: 7821 (attached)
- Preferred initial cadence: monthly in arrears
- VAT number: ESB12345678 (Spain)

Can you confirm which delivery modes you support and recommend for a first invoice? Also please confirm the billing contact we should use on your side (email and person). If you can send a sample invoice showing how VAT and PO will be represented, that would help us speed AP setup.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Lopez
Senior AP Manager, Horizon Health
attachments: PO_7821.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice and billing setup for PO 7821

Hi Marta — thanks for the details and the PO. Quick answers below and a plan for the first invoice: 

- Delivery modes: we support both approaches. Our default is portal-first (AP push + email copy), but we can also do email-only if you prefer. For most customers the portal plus an email copy reduces manual AP intake errors.
- Billing contact on our side: Laura Bennett (finance operations) will be the primary contact for invoice ownership; inbound emails can go to billing@redwoodinference.com and Laura will loop in Ben for collection questions.
- VAT handling: we'll include VAT line and your VAT number on the invoice. Please confirm whether the VAT is recoverable on your side; otherwise we'll mark it as included on the invoice.

Action plan: 
1) Laura will generate a sample invoice template (PDF) and send it to you today showing PO 7821 and VAT line.
2) We will enable portal push and also send a PDF to accounts-payable@horizonhealth.com for the first two cycles to help your AP ingest the file.
3) Please confirm preferred remittance method (SEPA vs wire) and provide any beneficiary references to include on the invoice so reconciliation is easier.

If you want email-only, reply and we'll skip portal provisioning.

Thanks — I'll loop Laura in now.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@horizonhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@horizonhealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice and billing setup for PO 7821

Hi Logan / Laura — thanks for the quick reply. Horizon prefers email PDF delivery to accounts-payable@horizonhealth.com as our AP system pulls attachments automatically; we can enable portal pickup later.

Details: 
- Please send invoices to accounts-payable@horizonhealth.com and also cc invoices@horizonhealth.com (our internal collector).
- PO: 7821 (please include on invoice header and line items if possible)
- VAT: ESB12345678 — please show VAT as a separate line item.
- Remittance: SEPA is preferred; we can accept wire but SEPA is easier. I'll attach the PO.

Could you attach a sample invoice PDF and confirm the remittance details you will include (bank name, IBAN, reference)? Our AP also asks whether Redwood can provide an XML/CSV extract for automated ingestion later on.

Best,
Marta

Hi Marta — looping in finance ops and payments. Thanks for confirming email delivery. Attached is a sample invoice (Redwood_SAMPLE_INV_7821.pdf) with the following notes:

- Invoice header: includes PO 7821 and your VAT ESB12345678
- VAT: shown as a separate line and subtotaled; if you need a net/VAT breakdown in a particular format, tell us and we can adjust the template.
- Remittance details included on the bottom of the invoice: 
  - Bank: Redwood Bank EU
  - IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819 (example)
  - SWIFT/BIC: NWBKGB2L
  - Reference: please use PO7821 / Horizon Health name for faster reconciliation
- Delivery: we'll send the invoice PDF to accounts-payable@horizonhealth.com and cc invoices@horizonhealth.com on the same day the invoice is posted to our portal. For the first two cycles we'll keep both channels active, then move to email-only if that's easier for your team.
- Machine ingestion: we can provide an XML or CSV extract; Ben (cc'd) will follow up with a sample schema so your AP team can validate parsing.

Next steps for us: Ben will drop the XML/CSV sample and Kimberly will confirm whether SEPA collection info requires any additional vendor onboarding on our side. Expect the first invoice (prorated start month) to be posted on 2026-08-01 and emailed the same day.

Thanks — let us know if anything else is needed to complete AP onboarding.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
